transcript: Modern people live more conveniently than ever before, but at a cost The health of body and mind tends to be neglected Lung function weakens without exercise And muscle mass diminishes if not used A sedentary lifestyle becomes a factor In diabetes and heart disease The quality of sleep is also crucial Staring at a smartphone screen late at night Exposes the brain to intense light And sleep becomes shallow Consequently, the next day's concentration drops considerably On the mental side, the number of people carrying anxiety and depression is growing The more intense the competition in society becomes The heavier the burden What is necessary to maintain health is nothing special A 30-minute walk each day, a balanced diet, 7 hours of sleep And not hesitating to ask for help when in trouble Body and mind are inseparable If you move your body, your mind grows lighter If your mind is stable, your body will also recover Health is the accumulation of small daily habits

segments.text: Modern people live more conveniently than ever before, but at a cost
The health of body and mind tends to be neglected
Lung function weakens without exercise
And muscle mass diminishes if not used
A sedentary lifestyle becomes a factor
In diabetes and heart disease
The quality of sleep is also crucial
Staring at a smartphone screen late at night
Exposes the brain to intense light
And sleep becomes shallow
Consequently, the next day's concentration drops considerably
On the mental side, the number of people carrying anxiety and depression is growing
The more intense the competition in society becomes
The heavier the burden
What is necessary to maintain health is nothing special
A 30-minute walk each day, a balanced diet, 7 hours of sleep
And not hesitating to ask for help when in trouble
Body and mind are inseparable
If you move your body, your mind grows lighter
If your mind is stable, your body will also recover
Health is the accumulation of small daily habits
